title: The first audit sweep failed every source, and two of the three causes were in the instrument
symptom: 8 of 8 sources failed, three at precision 0.000, including one whose labels are demonstrably valid.
root_cause: (1) class names like ['0','1','2'] were used as prompts, so the probe asked for 'a photo of a 0'; (2) an open-vocabulary detector cannot see a 30-pixel weed, and this corpus is small-object heavy; (3) one source genuinely had sub-pixel boxes.
correction_made: Class names accepted as prompts only when they are words; boxes under 32 px counted separately and the decision made on audited_precision_excl_small; a calibrate mode that runs the probe against human-labelled cwd12 first; all prior verdicts cleared as mis-measured.
